text: In June 2020, the City Planning Division initiated the Growth Plan Conformity and Municipal Comprehensive Review ("MCR") which includes the delineation of 180+ potential Major Transit Station Areas (MTSAs) to meet Provincial minimum intensification requirements. A subset of MTSAs will be identified as Protected Major Transit Station Areas (PMTSAs), where the in-effect inclusionary zoning framework can be implemented. An equity lens is being applied to this work program that prioritizes the delineation of PMTSAs to enable the implementation of inclusionary zoning as an affordable housing tool, where market conditions could support it. This report will be the basis for consultation for draft Official Plan Amendment (OPA) 540, which delineates 23 potential PMTSAs and Site and Area Specific Policies (SASPs) along Bloor Street West, Bloor Street East and Danforth Avenue.
